__broaden__.ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if he should see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also Ἴδη — Mount Ida, near Troy; fem. dat. sg., place where, after ἐν
